correctness.rationale: Using the planar mixed-area first variation, V(K,L)=1/2 sum_edges edge_length h_L(normal), edge normals from a regular n-gon reduce modulo 2pi/m to gcd(n,m) copies of a centered grid of n/g points. The exact finite cosine/Dirichlet sum is (g sin(pi/m)/sin(alpha)) cos d(theta), with alpha=pi*g/(nm). Thus A=A0+2C cos d, valid also at support-switch boundaries by continuity. Folding uniform orientation modulo 2alpha yields d~Uniform[0,alpha], exact CDF and density; variance follows from integrated cosine and Taylor expansion var(cos(alpha U))=alpha^4/45+O(alpha^6) as n,m ->infty. Independently compared against 245 geometric convex hulls of pairwise vertex sums for n,m=3..9, five angles each; max absolute discrepancy 7.11e-15. Finite checks supplement the proof.
